channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Shake Shack: Any Frozen Custard for $3
item.description: Use code CUSTARDTIME at any kiosk, on the Shake Shack app, or at shakeshack.com to get any frozen custard for $3 — valid through August 19. (Through August 19, 2026)

item.title: TCBY: BOGO 45% Off — 45th Anniversary
item.description: Today only, August 4, TCBY celebrates its 45th birthday with a buy-one-get-one 45% off deal on a second purchase of equal or lesser value all day at participating locations. (August 4, 2026)

item.title: Krispy Kreme: Buy Any Dozen, Get a Dozen Glazed for $1
item.guid: Krispy Kreme-Buy Any Dozen, Get a Dozen Glazed for $1-2026-08-04
item.description: Purchase any dozen doughnuts and add a dozen Original Glazed for just $1 — a verified current offer reported active this week. (Limited time)

item.title: Insomnia Cookies: Buy 12 Cookies, Get 4 Free
item.description: Order 12 warm cookies online or in the app and get 4 additional cookies free — a standing late-night deal at participating locations. (Limited time)

item.title: Papa Johns: 50% Off All Regular-Price Pizzas — Carryout
item.guid: Papa Johns-50% Off All Regular-Price Pizzas — Carry-2026-08-04
item.description: Get half off any size pizza with any crust and toppings when you choose carryout online or in the app; use code 50OFFCO if the discount does not apply automatically. (Through August 16, 2026)

item.title: Taco Bell: $1 Meximelt — Today Only
item.description: For August 4, 2026 only, get a Meximelt for $1 from 8 AM to 11:59 PM PT at participating Taco Bell locations nationwide. (August 4, 2026)

item.title: Subway: BOGO Footlong Deal — $5
item.description: Buy one footlong sub and get a second footlong for $5 — a current limited-time offer reported active through the Subway app this week. (Limited time)

item.title: Sonic: $7 Big Deal Meal
item.description: Sonic's $7 Big Deal Meal is available every day, plus a $1.99 everyday value menu featuring a Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger, Chicken Wrap, and more. (Ongoing)

item.title: Denny's: Slammin' Meal Deals from $5.99
item.description: Denny's all-day Slammin' Meal Deals value menu offers breakfast, lunch, and dinner options starting at $5.99, available at participating locations anytime — great for late-night visits. (Ongoing)

item.title: KFC: $7 Box Feast Meal
item.description: Get a KFC Snacker, 5-piece Nuggets, fries, a medium drink, and a dipping sauce bundled for $7 — available online and in the app at participating locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: McDonald's: Extra Value Meals for $4
item.description: McDonald's is currently offering Extra Value Meals at the $4 price point, part of its ongoing value-focused lineup available via the app and in-restaurant. (Ongoing)

item.title: Chipotle: Free Delivery on $10+ Digital Orders
item.description: Chipotle is waiving its delivery fee (typically $1-$3 per order) on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed. Only a saving if you were ordering delivery anyway; service fees still apply. (Limited time)

item.title: Panera: $4.99 Mix & Match Value Menu
item.description: Half- and cup-sized portions of soups, salads, and sandwiches from a 10-item menu for $4.99 each, and every item comes with a free side (baguette, chips, or apple). Pair any two for a full meal under $10 - in cafes and online, no membership needed. (Ongoing)
